checkout_review.field_labels: inset labels legible on first paint (First Name*, Last Name*, Email*, phone placeholder), address block gated

checkout_review.plan_terms: monthly plan terms next to the submit button with a required consent box, shown only while the plan card is selected
checkout_review.pending_live_sdk: card field centering, express wallet mount and selected/deselected interaction need the campaign api key (SDK hydration)

template_residue_review.copy_residue: none: starter 'Package Title' fallback replaced by the copy-deck plan names; no lorem, Product Name, Your headline, TODO or [VERIFY] on any page
template_residue_review.sales_copy_parity: visible text equals the source sales page word for word (ratio 0.9995); the one removal is the FAQ's 'Express is $5.97.', the store has no express method
template_residue_review.gate: tools/mediclab/check_funnel.py fails the build on any of these strings

evidence.commerce_flow_review: glp1-support CTAs -> /berberine-checkout/?forceBundleId=plan|one (both offer blocks in sync) -> success /berberine-offer/ -> accept and decline /berberine-thank-you/. Upsell: hero-5 package + BERBERINE45 voucher ($29.97), no countdown, no ratings. Receipt binds order.*. Storefront routes go to the sales page with the query string.
